crossRefs.note: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

translations.web: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
translations.bsb: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
translations.kjv: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
translations.asv: He hath given food unto them that fear him: He will ever be mindful of his covenant.
